description: This file defines a Router class responsible for routing HTTP requests to specific controller methods or static files within a PHP web framework. It includes methods for registering GET and POST routes, static file serving, fallback route handling, and executing the routing logic based on the incoming request URI and method.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: A class providing static methods to register routes, serve static files, define fallback handlers, and execute the routing logic for incoming HTTP requests.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Registers a GET route with a specified path and controller, supporting controllers as class-method arrays or simple handlers.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Registers a POST route with a specified path and controller.

methods.name: static
methods.description: Defines a static file directory for serving static assets; throws an exception if the path does not exist.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Sets a fallback view or handler when a route is not matched.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the routing process: handles static file requests, matches routes based on URI and method, invokes controllers or fallback handlers, and sets appropriate HTTP status codes.
